naicsTitle: Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
title: Most-cited OSHA standards in veterinary and other professional services (NAICS 5419)
description: OSHA citations FY2022–FY2026 for NAICS 5419, which includes veterinary services: hazard communication leads with 173 of 580 citations.
opening: Across NAICS 5419, which includes veterinary services, photography studios and polling firms, the most-cited OSHA standard from FY2022 to FY2026 was 1910.1200, hazard communication, with 173 of 580 citations, followed by 1910.134 respiratory protection with 37.
patternsSummary: Hazard communication (1910.1200) leads NAICS 5419 with 173 of the 580 citations. The other substance and protective equipment standards near the top are respiratory protection (1910.134, 37), general PPE requirements (1910.132, 30), formaldehyde (1910.1048, 29) and eye and face protection (1910.133, 21). Medical services and first aid (1910.151, 27), portable fire extinguishers (1910.157, 21), exit routes (1910.37, 16) and the electrical rules in 1910.303 and 1910.305 (15 each) also rank high, ahead of lockout/tagout (1910.147, 13), walking-working surfaces (1910.22, 12), providing records to government representatives (1904.40, 12), incident reporting (1904.39, 11) and ionizing radiation (1910.1096, 11). In all, 23 standards were cited 5 or more times; the ranked table has the full list.
penaltiesSummary: Based on 312 penalties from FY2022–FY2026, the median was $2,500, and the middle half fell between $750 and $5,497. Of all citations, 64% were classified serious, 35% other-than-serious and 1% repeat, and willful citations were rare.
